summary: Upload a file for a page import
description: Needs manage permission on the page's items. The raw file is the request body (streamed, not buffered). It is kept until it is opened. Errors carry a backup.error.<code> message id: invalid-types, weak-passphrase, wrong-passphrase, not-a-backup (404), invalid-archive, newer-format, too-large (413), busy (409), token-expired (410), name-taken, restore-failed, plan-changed (409), partial-replace, wrong-kind, not-importable.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The page kind the file is imported on

encrypted.description: The file needs its passphrase to be opened
